package.name: aav_mux_state
package.description: command_mux_state (Rust, rclrs): who is driving. twist_mux never says which driver it passes on; this node reads twist_mux's own parameter files, hears the same /drivers/*/cmd_vel inputs and lock topics, applies twist_mux's rule, and publishes the driver, its priority, its age, the locks that are on and the inputs they hold on /control/command_mux/state (TODO 247, the debug screen). The rule is the mux-state-core crate, with no ROS.
